part.text:
Fixed the duplicate-sample rollover bug in `tsdb/head_append.go`.

The XOR chunk size-limit path now checks `c.maxTime >= t` before creating a new head chunk. A duplicate or out-of-order sample is discarded without becoming the first sample in a new chunk, preventing overlapping chunk boundaries.
